apps.name: RagaMentor-iOS
apps.versionDescription: v1.4.3 — SequencePlayer migration Phase P-D: Varisai patterns now play through the shared SequencePlayer core via a thin VarisaiAdapter with the seamless loop policy. The 60 ms-early seam wake and the live loop toggle move into the core; same steps, dheergam holds and legato overlaps. Ear-test gates: Varisai loop at 8x with the seam on the highlight grid; toggle flipped mid-pass takes effect at the seam.
apps.localizedDescription: RagaMentor native: LoopLab — slow down songs, keep pitch, loop sections. Built by GitHub Actions + fastlane on every push to main.

versions.localizedDescription: Phrases migrate to the shared SequencePlayer (P-C).
